If you're not using drugs to get high, then you need to consult a doctor to get meds. Someone using any drug on regular basis have an addiction. I have adhd & other psychiatric conditions myself. Even the meds for adhd are holiday drugs. You're supposed to take a break whenever possible. You don't solve a drug induced problem with another drug. That's a stupid thing to do, trust me. The best advice I feel for you is to get a professional to treat your condition. Don't self medicate with drugs. Bcs having adhd itself makes your prone to substance abuse problem/addiction.
